test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_text_index_dense_postings ( text String, INDEX idx (text) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha', posting_list_codec = 'pfor') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.query: SELECT count() FROM t_text_index_dense_postings WHERE hasToken(text, 'the')
SELECT count() FROM t_text_index_dense_postings WHERE hasToken(text, 'and')
SELECT count() FROM t_text_index_dense_postings WHERE hasAllTokens(text, ['the', 'and'])
SELECT count() FROM t_text_index_dense_postings WHERE hasAnyTokens(text, ['and', 'rare'])
